peer.scope: Saved independent selected bindings/shapes, metadata and receipt review; not full equivalence.

freeze.scope: Saved freeze observation; current runner captures excluded.

validation.scope: Saved author hash/coordinate/binding/denominator and history checks.

peer.scope: Sum of saved bounded/history/wording/metadata peer executions; overlapping checks not distinct proofs.

freeze.scope: Saved post-freeze check; 183 selected closure files, explicit exclusions.

manualCodeReview.claim: All data bytes read by the helper are selected input metadata or the fixed configuration; it never recursively copies the frozen closure.
manualCodeReview.basis: inputs built solely from spec.inputFiles via read_selected; outputs use only core | support; closure members are metadata reference validation.

manualCodeReview.claim: The helper preserves each raw catalog and journal as exact input bytes; summaries and provenance are separately derived.
manualCodeReview.basis: pending[destination] = inputs[name] for raw outputs and aliases; no row serialization or locator mutation.

manualCodeReview.claim: All output writes are beneath caller out using validated relative names; existing different bytes are rejected.
manualCodeReview.basis: final atomic_write(out / relative(name), raw); inspected dependency atomic_write rejects changed existing bytes and symlinks.

manualCodeReview.claim: The helper does not mutate old ledger/global journals, classify modes or increase feature confirmations.
manualCodeReview.basis: no such input paths or output names in final config; helper publication metadata fields explicitly globalRecordsAdded 0, runtimeConfirmedRecords 0, featureDenominatorEstablished/fullAnalysisCompleted false.

manualCodeReview.claim: Atomic publication mutation branches and end-to-end publisher behavior were inspected only, not executed in this review.
manualCodeReview.basis: review does not import or call helper/publisher; this is not an execution receipt for the publisher.

results.check: fixed baseline and exactly two catalogs
